name: Shalimar Paints Limited
about: Shalimar Paints Limited engages in the manufacturing and marketing of paints and coatings in India, Nepal, the United Arab Emirates, Bhutan, Seychelles, and internationally. The company offers decorative paints; and industrial paints, including protective, can, and pipeline coatings. It also provides apply supply services; and services in heavy machinery, truck body, agricultural machinery, frp components, auto parts, metal door, construction equipment, industrial equipment, and others. In addition, the company offers interior, exterior, metal, wood, floor, waterproofing paint products; ancillary, such as magic brush, magic roller, magic dry sandpaper, magic wet and dry sandpaper, magic masking tape, and magic spray paint; and protective, packaging, and marine coatings. It offers its products under the Magic, Mela, Color Space, Hero, Zero Damp, Superlac, and Shalimar brand names. Shalimar Paints Limited was incorporated in 1902 and is based in Thane, India. Shalimar Paints Limited operates as a subsidiary of Hella Infra Market Limited.
